note: Up to EUR 750,000 per application. Consortium must include your own hogeschool, at least one Dutch university or research organisation and at least two professional-field partners (mkb or public), with at least 30% co-funding in cash or in kind. An intentieverklaring was mandatory and closed 3 September 2026, and the call page states new applications are currently not possible, so this round is probably shut for new entrants: worth confirming before planning around it.
title: RAAK-PRO November 2026 round (Regieorgaan SIA)
